cross_cutting_finding.finding_1_dead_absolute_gate: session_b_share is BELOW 0.50 on every one of the block's ten sessions (0.433, 0.486, 0.440, 0.448, 0.458, 0.452, 0.488, 0.487, 0.451, 0.445). GENERAL PROPOSAL (+n): when a block's session_b_share distribution never crosses the absolute gate, the gate must be evaluated BLOCK-RELATIVE (percentile within the block's own realized distribution) or replaced by the CROSS-CHANNEL divergence between the count-tape (session_b_share) and the size-weighted channels (session_signed_flow lots, big_print_b_share). Under the relative read, 20260601 (0.488) and 20260602 (0.487) are the block's two most buy-leaning sessions AND its two largest positive signed-flow sessions (+3796, +3524) - a signal the absolute gate erases entirely.

cross_cutting_finding.finding_3_channel_flip_as_the_price_free: Without price I cannot compute flow_conviction, so I cannot tell covering-discharge-UP from buy-absorption-FAILING-DOWN (the G18 0506 trap that burned this lens). The price-free substitute I used, and propose generally: watch the SIZE-WEIGHTED big_print_b_share while aggregate signed flow is strongly positive. If the big prints keep SELLING into the buying (0601: signed flow +3796 but big_print_b_share 0.436), the large absorber is still there and the buy-absorption-failing risk is UNRESOLVED - take the turn side small. When the big-print channel FLIPS to the buy side on a guard-clean sample (0602: +3524 with big_print_b_share 0.585 on n=122 prints) the absorber has stepped away and the accumulation is confirmed without ever seeing price. The two-session sequence 0601->0602 is the resolution event, and it is why 0603 carries more size and confidence than 0602 even though 0602 sits closer to the turn.
